podcast.title: Dear Dave, the plates miss you

hosts.Leyla: lives in Baku and loves a good plan
hosts.Sam: grew up in Manchester and once travelled with no plan at all

before.predict: Have you ever shared a flat or a room? Guess: who is moving in with Sam?

lines.t: Hi everyone, and welcome to the SpeakLab Podcast. I'm Leyla.
And I'm Sam. Today's topic is sharing a home. And from next week, I'll have a roommate.
Who?
My friend Tom. After his breakup he needs a change for a month, so he's coming to Baku.
Poor Tom. Are you ready to share your small flat?
I hope so. At university I lived with three roommates. It wasn't always easy.
Why not?
One of them, Dave, never did any chores. His dishes stayed in the sink for a week.
Oh no. What did you do?
I left notes on the fridge: "Dear Dave, the plates miss you." [laugh]
Did it work?
No. In the end we sat down and talked. We had to clear the air.
My mum always says: pull your weight, or don't complain.
Wise woman. What about you? Did you ever share a room?
With my sister, for eighteen years! She was tidy, and I was… not.
So your side was a mess?
A big mess. Books everywhere. And no privacy at all — she read my diary!
[chuckle] So how did you survive?
We made a compromise: I cleaned my side on Sundays, and she stopped reading my diary.
Good deal. So, for Tom: we split the chores, we split the bills, and he cooks on Fridays.
Here's your question for your next SpeakLab call: have you ever shared a room or a flat — and what was the hardest part?
Mine was Dave's dishes. See you next time!
Bye for now!
